Cult Classics are films that may or may not have been popular at the time they were released but have managed to maintain popularity over time. These films are often held in very high esteem by the people who enjoy them. They tend to be films that are good no matter what age you are or how many times you've seen them. They somehow manage to withstand the test of time, like Blade Runner.

...or they could just be so terrible that people love to watch and laugh at them, like Samurai Cop.
